facts.title: Meet Pau
facts.text: Pau Vicente is a speaker, freelance coach, and social media marketing & branding strategist. Her message is ‘Lead with Love. Grow with Purpose.’ She helps aspiring freelancers build with confidence.

facts.title: Her experience
facts.text: Pau began as a Marketing Assistant at a corporate company in the Philippines, organizing corporate events and collaborating with teams. After experiencing burnout and wanting more room to grow, she applied as a Virtual Assistant during the pandemic. She started without experience or a roadmap and learned through trial and error. Her first client helped her feel valued, build confidence, work with multiple clients, and develop her skills. She has navigated difficult clients, multiple accounts, and workdays sometimes beyond 14 hours.

facts.title: Mentoring & Cross Core
facts.text: As opportunities grew beyond what she could personally take on, Pau began mentoring close friends who asked how to start freelancing. This became a passion for helping others build meaningful careers. She now leads Cross Core, a digital marketing agency built to create opportunities, equip aspiring freelancers with practical skills, and help others grow alongside her.

facts.title: Freelance 101
facts.text: Freelance 101 is for students, career shifters, and beginners. It covers what freelancing really is, different freelance careers, finding your niche, preparing your portfolio, getting your first client, and common mistakes beginners make.

facts.title: Social Media Marketing
facts.text: Social Media Marketing covers the fundamentals of social media marketing, creating engaging content, content planning, building a personal brand, understanding clients, and working with businesses.

facts.title: Inspirational Leadership
facts.text: Inspirational Leadership is for students, young professionals, leaders, church communities, and organizations. It covers leading with purpose and integrity, building influence beyond a title, developing a growth mindset, overcoming setbacks and embracing challenges, leading yourself before leading others, character, resilience and service, and turning experiences into opportunities to inspire others.

facts.title: Why invite Pau
facts.text: Pau brings real-world freelancing experience, practical strategies, meaningful stories that inspire action, and clear explanations of complex concepts. Her speaking style combines practical strategies with real-life experiences in an encouraging learning environment. She supports knowledge, confidence, continuous growth, the right mindset, and purposeful next steps.

facts.title: Participant outcomes
facts.text: Participants will learn how freelancing works, identify a niche that suits them, learn practical social media marketing fundamentals, build confidence in starting a freelance journey, understand how branding creates opportunities, and take clear next steps toward becoming a freelancer. Jobs, clients, income, and career success are not guaranteed.

facts.title: Participant support
facts.text: Participants receive access to a free coaching session to ask questions, seek guidance, and receive practical advice as they begin or continue their freelancing journey. A duration, scheduling policy, booking link, and unlimited access have not been provided. Contact Pau to discuss the arrangement; this is not an instant public booking service.

facts.title: Ideal audiences
facts.text: Pau’s sessions serve college students, fresh graduates, aspiring freelancers, virtual assistants, career shifters, entrepreneurs, church communities, youth organizations, and corporate teams exploring freelancing or digital skills.

facts.title: Session formats
facts.text: Available session formats listed in the portfolio are keynote speaking, workshops, seminars, webinars, panel discussions, coaching sessions, and Q&A. Fees, dates, session lengths, event capacity, and travel availability must be confirmed directly with Pau.
